actions.action: Water the ivy lightly, only when the top inch of soil is dry
Check that the ivy pot has drainage holes
Place the ivy in bright indirect light away from drafts and cold glass
Optionally move the ivy to a smaller pot
Alternatively add more cuttings to the ivy pot
Alternatively root the ivy in a jar of water before potting
Gently tug the cutting after 3-4 weeks to test for roots
Water or mist the cactus cutting sparingly, letting the soil dry partway
Use a gritty mix by adding perlite or orchid bark if the soil is dense
Loosen the twine on the cactus stake so segments aren't pinched
If a cactus segment rots, remove it, let the cutting dry 1-2 days and replant in fresh dry mix
Give the cactus bright indirect light
